name: lost-and-found
description: Finds a lost child in a mall from a guard's description: a camera graph decides where to look, CreativAI looks.

scripts.find:a: node demo/pipeline/find-child.js --case A --child "a small boy of about 6 in a bright red t-shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers" --family "a man in a long white robe (thobe) with a red-and-white checkered headscarf (shemagh) carrying a dark green shopping bag, and a woman in a long black cloak (abaya) with a light grey headscarf" --arrived 14:00
